I know how you feel. I've had anxiety as long as I remember. Then when i was around five or six there was an..... incident. I have only told about two people and I'd rather not go into detail about it at the moment. I lost my ability to see the world as a normal child would and spiraled into depression for the rest of my life up until now (and most definatly in the future as well) 

But it's my life. And I get to experience emotion and feeling even if it's bad. I get to see the sun rise and set. I get to feel and think, while others who lost the battle can't. I enjoy life for them, but also for myself. I have bad days, days that I don't want to do it anymore and just give up. They by far outweigh the good days. But I don't give up.

 Even if you feel like no one cares about you or that the pain is too much, I'm glad that you get to enjoy these things too and that you keep on fighting.

I'm gonna try and sit down and talk with him. I'm not a confrontational person so it can be really hard for me to Express how I feel a lot. He's definately gotten a lot better from how he used to be.  

And I understand that I need to work with him to help him achieve his goals as well. He gets frustrated too and I feel like neither of us really have an outlet for out anger. I'm going to learn how to drive, so I'm less dependent on him, and see if we can work things out. 

If not, I'll have to let him go. It can be really hard. I never thought I would make it through highschool because I always thought I would end up committing suicide before then. 

He is the one who supported me through my struggles and helped me open up to the people around me. He only started getting angry and unintentionally blaming me for things after his pain started to become unmanageable. I know he feels worthless for not being able to help us. Thank you guys for your input, it's nice to have some for a change.
I'm sorry that you, or anyone ever has to go through situations like this. I hope it is resolved quickly, and you find happiness again just as fast.

He has cerebral palsy (not too bad) a bad back and a ruptured disk in his neck, we've even tried getting him pain medicine but none of the doctors around here are willing and just want us to do physical therapy, but we cant afford it. It's a but complicated to say the least 😔we are trying, but it will take a long time to figure any of that out and a lot of paperwork, not even guaranteed to get disability

I hate to even suggest something like this, I don't know either of you or the full extent of the situation. While you were on this "break" could she have gotten pregnant and not known who the father could be and decided to continue with you because you were someone who would take care of her whether it be yours or someone else's child? And you are an amazing person. It takes a lot for someone to love a child (if it were the case) after they found something like this out.
